title: Shares of Apple Inc ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) have bullishl
text:
Shares of Apple Inc ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) have bullishly opened above the pivot of $179.12 today and have reached the first resistance level of $180.86. Investors may be interested in a cross of the next upside pivot targets of $181.73 and $184.34. 

There is potential upside of 5.9% for shares of Apple Inc based on a current price of $181.11 and an average consensus analyst price target of $191.85. Apple Inc shares have support at the 50-day moving average (MA) of $149.29 and additional support at the 200-day MA of $130.69. 

In the past 52 weeks, shares of Apple Inc have traded between a low of $96.42 and a high of $181.18 and are now at $181.11, which is 88% above that low price. Over the past week, the 200-day moving average (MA) has remained constant while the 50-day MA has remained constant. 

SmarTrend recommended that subscribers consider buying shares of Apple Inc on February 14th, 2018 as our proprietary SmarTrend analytics indicated a new Uptrend was in progress when shares hit $165.21. Since that recommendation, shares of Apple Inc have risen 8.9%. We continue to monitor AAPL for any potential shift so investors can protect gains and will alert SmarTrend subscribers immediately.
